facts.business: Sarveshwar Foods Limited is an integrated food company with a 136-year legacy in the rice industry, operating across premium Basmati rice, organic foods, healthy staples, and value-added FMCG products under the Sarveshwar and NIMBARK brands, managing the entire value chain from farmer engagement to retail and exports.

segments.name: Premium Basmati and Specialty Rice (Sarveshwar brand)

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matter: Inventory Valuation and Physical Verification - Torn bags and spoiled stock found at various outlets included in stock records without apparent adjustments; different grades of rice recorded at uniform rates without differentiation in value. Auditor concluded inventory is fairly stated in all material respects.

key_risks: Inventory condition and valuation risks (torn bags, spoiled stock, uniform grading)
